decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the product feed, removing several items that were accessories rather than speakers, such as battery replacements, carrying cases, and handle straps. I narrowed my consideration set to five high-quality options: the JBL Charge 5, Bose SoundLink Color II, a renewed JBL Flip 5, the NOTABRICK portable speaker, and the Sony SRS-RA3000. Among these, the JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is the clear winner. It boasts an exceptional 4.8 rating across more than 16,000 reviews, indicating very high customer satisfaction. Its combination of IP67 waterproofing, USB charge-out functionality, and 20 hours of playtime makes it the most versatile and reliable choice for a portable speaker in this price range.
